# Purpose

Three datasets, with three roles.

* **Danish fire losses** ($\xi\approx0.58>1/2$, infinite variance plausible) and **S&P 500 daily log-losses**
  ($\xi\approx0.2$) illustrate the two asymptotic regimes of the article. Their tails are modelled by the GPD (POT);
  the stable law does **not** fit them (goodness-of-fit tests reject it and $1/\widehat\alpha$ is incompatible with the
  tail index).
* **Boeing daily log-losses**, 1 July 1997 – 31 December 2003 ($n=1635$), the example of Borak, Härdle & Weron (2005)
  for which the stable law is accepted by the Anderson–Darling and Kolmogorov tests, illustrate the stable model:
  fit, goodness of fit, consistency of $1/\widehat\alpha$ with the tail estimators (calibrated by simulation, because
  the Hill estimator is strongly biased for stable samples with $\alpha>1.5$: McCulloch, 1997; Weron, 2001), and the
  superquantiles implied by the fitted stable law (Theorem 6.1) against the nonparametric estimates.

On each dataset we estimate the CVaR (quadratic generator) and the $\asinh$-Bregman superquantile,
$\gamma'(x)=\asinh(x/s)$ with $s=\mathrm{IQR}/1.349$ computed once on the full sample and then held fixed, with the five
estimators of the article: empirical, batch kernel ($h_n=\widehat s\,n^{-0.3}$), recursive with indicator weights,
recursive kernel ($h_n=\widehat s\,n^{-0.4}$, Newton gains), recursive with steps $n^{-0.8}$ and Polyak–Ruppert
averaging. The stable diagnostics are: parametric-bootstrap KS/CvM/AD tests; QCV tests of Pitera, Chechkin &
Wyłomańska (2022) and the exact Monte Carlo confidence set obtained by inverting them (Beaulieu, Dufour & Khalaf, 2014);
Hill and QQ (Kratz & Resnick, 1996) estimators of $\xi$; aggregation diagnostic of Burnecki, Wyłomańska & Chechkin
(2015); and, when installed, the package `MixStable`.

All tables are written in LaTeX to `app_out/tables/` and all figures in PDF to `app_out/figures/`, with the file
names used by the article: copy them next to `article_revise.tex`.

# Function library

```{r library}
## ---------------------------------------------------------------- generators
make_gen <- function(type = c("quad", "asinh"), s = 1) {
  type <- match.arg(type)
  if (type == "quad") list(type = "quad", s = NA,
                           g1 = function(x) x, g2 = function(x) rep(1, length(x)), ginv = function(y) y)
  else list(type = "asinh", s = s,
            g1 = function(x) asinh(x / s), g2 = function(x) 1 / (s * sqrt(1 + (x / s)^2)),
            ginv = function(y) s * sinh(y))
}
robust_scale <- function(x) { s <- IQR(x) / 1.349; if (!is.finite(s) || s <= 0) s <- sd(x); s }

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- empirical estimator (Definition 2.1)
#' Returns Q (empirical quantile), T = gamma'(SQ) and SQ.
sq_emp <- function(x, p, gen) {
  xs <- sort(x); n <- length(xs); k <- ceiling(n * p - 1e-9); q <- xs[k]
  up <- if (k < n) sum(gen$g1(xs[(k + 1):n])) else 0
  T <- ((k - n * p) * gen$g1(q) + up) / (n * (1 - p))
  list(Q = q, T = T, SQ = gen$ginv(T))
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- kernel estimator (Definition 2.2)
.GL <- local({ m <- 40; i <- seq_len(m - 1); b <- i / sqrt(4 * i^2 - 1)
  J <- matrix(0, m, m); J[cbind(i, i + 1)] <- b; J[cbind(i + 1, i)] <- b
  e <- eigen(J, symmetric = TRUE); o <- order(e$values); list(x = e$values[o], w = 2 * e$vectors[1, o]^2) })
sq_kernel <- function(x, p, gen, h) {
  n <- length(x); t <- quantile(x, p, type = 1, names = FALSE)
  for (it in 1:50) {
    z <- (t - x) / h; st <- (mean(pnorm(z)) - p) / (mean(dnorm(z)) / h); t <- t - st
    if (abs(st) < 1e-12 * (1 + abs(t))) break
  }
  a <- (t - x) / h
  if (gen$type == "quad") T <- sum(x * pnorm(-a) + h * dnorm(a)) / (n * (1 - p))
  else {
    far <- a < -8; band <- abs(a) <= 8; ab <- a[band]; half <- (8 - ab) / 2; mid <- (8 + ab) / 2
    Z <- outer(half, .GL$x) + mid
    T <- (sum(gen$g1(x[far])) + sum(drop((gen$g1(x[band] + h * Z) * dnorm(Z)) %*% .GL$w) * half)) / (n * (1 - p))
  }
  list(Q = t, T = T, SQ = gen$ginv(T))
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- recursive estimators (Section 3)
#' Chronological Robbins-Monro recursion on theta = (Q, T), T = gamma'(SQ).
#'   weight = "indicator": W_i = 1{X_i <= Q_{i-1}};  weight = "kernel": W_i = Phi((Q_{i-1} - X_i) / h_i),
#'   h_i = s_hat * i^(-a).
#'   type = "newton": steps 1/i with the Newton gain A^{-1} computed on a warm start of n0 observations and frozen;
#'   type = "pr": steps i^(-rho), same gain, Polyak-Ruppert average of the T-iterates.
#' Returns the final estimate and the trajectory.
sq_recursive <- function(x, p, gen, type = c("newton", "pr"), weight = c("kernel", "indicator"),
                         a = params$a_rec, rho = params$rho_pr, n0 = NULL, every = 10L) {
  type <- match.arg(type); weight <- match.arg(weight); n <- length(x); r <- 1 - p
  if (is.null(n0)) n0 <- min(max(200L, ceiling(20 / r)), floor(n / 4))
  w <- sq_emp(x[1:n0], p, gen); Q <- w$Q; T <- w$T; Tbar <- T
  x0 <- x[1:n0]; s0 <- robust_scale(x0); hp <- s0 * n0^(-0.2)
  fq <- max(mean(dnorm((Q - x0) / hp)) / hp, 0.1 * r / s0)
  g11 <- 1 / fq; g21 <- -gen$g1(Q) / r            # Newton gain A^-1, frozen after the warm start
  gx <- gen$g1(x); path <- rep(NA_real_, n); path[n0] <- gen$ginv(T)
  for (i in (n0 + 1):n) {
    st <- if (type == "newton") 1 / i else i^(-rho)
    W <- if (weight == "kernel") pnorm((Q - x[i]) / (s0 * i^(-a))) else as.numeric(x[i] <= Q)
    d1 <- W - p; d2 <- T - gx[i] * (1 - W) / r
    Q <- Q - st * g11 * d1
    T <- T - st * (g21 * d1 + d2)
    if (type == "pr") Tbar <- Tbar + (T - Tbar) / (i - n0 + 1)
    path[i] <- gen$ginv(if (type == "pr") Tbar else T)
  }
  keep <- c(seq(n0, n, by = every), n)
  list(SQ = path[n], n0 = n0, path = data.frame(i = keep, est = path[keep]))
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- asymptotic variance (Theorem 4.8)
#' Plug-in sigma^2 = Var((gamma'(X) - gamma'(Q))_+) / ((1-p)^2 gamma''(SQ)^2).
sigma2_hat <- function(x, p, gen, est = sq_emp(x, p, gen)) {
  z <- pmax(gen$g1(x) - gen$g1(est$Q), 0); var(z) / ((1 - p)^2 * gen$g2(est$SQ)^2)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- tail index: Hill, QQ (Kratz-Resnick), GPD
hill <- function(x, k) { xs <- sort(x[x > 0], decreasing = TRUE); mean(log(xs[1:k])) - log(xs[k + 1]) }
#' QQ-estimator of Kratz & Resnick (1996): least-squares slope of the Pareto QQ-plot
#' (-log(i/(k+1)), log X_(n-i+1)), i = 1..k, an estimator of xi = 1/alpha.
qq_xi <- function(x, k) {
  xs <- sort(x[x > 0], decreasing = TRUE)[1:k]; u <- -log(seq_len(k) / (k + 1))
  sum((u - mean(u)) * (log(xs) - mean(log(xs)))) / sum((u - mean(u))^2)
}
gpd_fit <- function(y) {                                   # excesses y > 0
  nll <- function(par) { xi <- par[1]; sg <- exp(par[2]); if (abs(xi) < 1e-8) xi <- 1e-8
    z <- 1 + xi * y / sg; if (any(z <= 0)) return(1e10); length(y) * log(sg) + (1 / xi + 1) * sum(log(z)) }
  best <- NULL
  for (s0 in list(c(0.1, log(mean(y))), c(0.5, log(median(y))), c(0.3, log(sd(y))))) {
    o <- tryCatch(optim(s0, nll, control = list(maxit = 5000, reltol = 1e-12)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(o) && (is.null(best) || o$value < best$value)) best <- o
  }
  c(xi = best$par[1], sigma = exp(best$par[2]))
}
#' POT-GPD CVaR at level p (threshold u = Q_pu, p > pu), finite if xi < 1.
pot_cvar <- function(x, p, pu = 0.90) {
  u <- quantile(x, pu, type = 1, names = FALSE); y <- x[x > u] - u; th <- gpd_fit(y); zeta <- length(y) / length(x)
  q <- u + th[["sigma"]] / th[["xi"]] * (((1 - p) / zeta)^(-th[["xi"]]) - 1)
  c(xi = th[["xi"]], sigma = th[["sigma"]], q = q,
    cvar = if (th[["xi"]] < 1) (q + th[["sigma"]] - th[["xi"]] * u) / (1 - th[["xi"]]) else Inf)
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- intervals
#' Basic bootstrap interval from resampling a statistic stat(x) (n-out-of-n or m-out-of-n).
#' With subsample size m and normalising rate a_k = k^r:  a_n (theta_hat - theta) ~ a_m (theta*_m - theta_hat).
boot_ci <- function(x, stat, m = length(x), rate = 0.5, B = 1000, level = 0.95) {
  n <- length(x); th <- stat(x)
  bs <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(b) stat(sample(x, m, replace = TRUE)), numeric(1))
  d <- quantile(bs - th, c((1 + level) / 2, (1 - level) / 2), na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE)
  c(lo = th - (m / n)^rate * d[1], hi = th - (m / n)^rate * d[2])
}
wald_ci <- function(x, p, gen, level = 0.95) {
  e <- sq_emp(x, p, gen); se <- sqrt(sigma2_hat(x, p, gen, e) / length(x)); z <- qnorm((1 + level) / 2)
  c(lo = e$SQ - z * se, hi = e$SQ + z * se)
}
#' Parametric bootstrap interval for the POT-GPD CVaR (the GPD is refitted on each sample).
pot_ci <- function(x, p, pu = 0.90, B = 500, level = 0.95) {
  fit <- pot_cvar(x, p, pu); u <- quantile(x, pu, type = 1, names = FALSE); n <- length(x)
  body <- x[x <= u]; k <- sum(x > u)
  bs <- vapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {
    nk <- rbinom(1, n, k / n)
    yk <- fit[["sigma"]] / fit[["xi"]] * (runif(nk)^(-fit[["xi"]]) - 1)
    pot_cvar(c(sample(body, n - nk, replace = TRUE), u + yk), p, pu)[["cvar"]]
  }, numeric(1))
  q <- quantile(bs[is.finite(bs)], c((1 - level) / 2, (1 + level) / 2), names = FALSE)
  c(est = fit[["cvar"]], lo = q[1], hi = q[2])
}

## ---------------------------------------------------------------- output helpers
fmt <- function(v, d) ifelse(is.finite(v), formatC(v, format = "f", digits = d), "--")
fmt_ci <- function(ci, d) if (all(is.finite(ci))) sprintf("[%s, %s]", fmt(ci[1], d), fmt(ci[2], d)) else "--"
fmt_p <- function(v) ifelse(!is.finite(v), "--", ifelse(v < 0.001, "$<0.001$", formatC(v, format = "f", digits = 3)))
write_tex <- function(lines, name) writeLines(lines, file.path(OUT, "tables", paste0(name, ".tex")))
save_fig <- function(pl, name, w = 12, h = 7) {
  print(pl); ggsave(file.path(OUT, "figures", paste0(name, ".pdf")), pl, width = w, height = h,
                    device = if (capabilities("cairo")) cairo_pdf else "pdf")
}
theme_article <- function(base = 14) theme_bw(base_size = base) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# Data

```{r data}
load_danish <- function() {
  if (nzchar(params$danish_csv)) return(as.numeric(read.csv(params$danish_csv)[[1]]))
  if (!requireNamespace("evir", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("evir")
  utils::data("danish", package = "evir", envir = environment())
  tm <- attr(danish, "times"); x <- as.numeric(danish)
  if (!is.null(tm)) x <- x[order(tm)]                      # chronological order for the recursion
  x
}
load_sp <- function() {
  if (nzchar(params$sp_csv)) { d <- read.csv(params$sp_csv); d <- d[order(as.Date(d$date)), ]
    return(list(x = -diff(log(d$close)), from = min(d$date), to = max(d$date))) }
  if (!requireNamespace("quantmod", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("quantmod")
  px <- quantmod::getSymbols("^GSPC", src = "yahoo", from = params$sp_from, to = params$sp_to, auto.assign = FALSE)
  cl <- as.numeric(quantmod::Cl(px)); x <- -diff(log(cl)); ok <- is.finite(x)
  list(x = x[ok], from = format(min(zoo::index(px))), to = format(max(zoo::index(px))))
}
load_boeing <- function() {
  if (nzchar(params$boeing_csv)) { d <- read.csv(params$boeing_csv); d <- d[order(as.Date(d$date)), ]
    return(list(x = -diff(log(d$close)), from = min(d$date), to = max(d$date))) }
  if (!requireNamespace("quantmod", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("quantmod")
  px <- quantmod::getSymbols("BA", src = "yahoo", from = params$boeing_from, to = params$boeing_to, auto.assign = FALSE)
  cl <- as.numeric(quantmod::Cl(px)); x <- -diff(log(cl)); ok <- is.finite(x)
  list(x = x[ok], from = format(min(zoo::index(px))), to = format(max(zoo::index(px))))
}
x_dan <- load_danish()
SP <- load_sp(); x_sp <- SP$x
BA <- load_boeing(); x_ba <- BA$x
cat(sprintf("Danish: n = %d.  S&P 500: n = %d daily log-losses, %s to %s.  Boeing: n = %d daily log-losses, %s to %s.\n",
            length(x_dan), length(x_sp), SP$from, SP$to, length(x_ba), BA$from, BA$to))
DATA <- list(`Danish fire losses` = x_dan, `S&P 500 daily log-losses` = x_sp, `Boeing daily log-losses` = x_ba)
```

# Superquantile estimates and confidence intervals

For each level $p$ and each functional (CVaR; $\asinh$ with $s=\mathrm{IQR}/1.349$):

* **Point estimates.** Empirical, kernel, recursive indicator, recursive kernel (Newton gains, steps $1/n$),
  recursive with steps $n^{-0.8}$ and Polyak–Ruppert averaging; recursive estimators in chronological order.
* **Regime.** $\Var\gamma'(X)<\infty$ always holds for the $\asinh$ generator; for the CVaR it requires $\xi<1/2$
  ($\xi$ estimated by POT–GPD maximum likelihood). Wald and $n$-out-of-$n$ intervals are given only in the regular regime.
* **Bootstrap.** $m$-out-of-$n$ basic bootstrap with $m=$ `m_frac`$\cdot n$ and rate $a_k=k^{1/2}$ (regular) or
  $a_k=k^{1-\widehat\xi}$ (CVaR with $\widehat\xi\in(1/2,1)$); intervals only if $m(1-p)\ge$ `min_exceed`.

```{r core}
EST <- c(empirical = "Empirical", kernel = "Kernel", rec_ind = "Rec. indicator",
         rec_ker = "Rec. kernel", rec_pr = "Rec. PR")
#' xi_regime: tail index used to decide the regime (default: POT-GPD estimate; for the stable model, 1/alpha).
analyse <- function(x, p_levels, label, pu = 0.90, xi_regime = NULL) {
  n <- length(x); s_iqr <- robust_scale(x); h_ker <- s_iqr * n^(-params$a_ker)
  u <- quantile(x, pu, type = 1, names = FALSE); pot <- gpd_fit(x[x > u] - u)
  xi <- if (is.null(xi_regime)) pot[["xi"]] else xi_regime; m <- floor(params$m_frac * n)
  funs <- list(
    list(key = "cvar",  lab = "CVaR", gen = make_gen("quad"),
         rate_m = if (xi < 0.5) 0.5 else if (xi < 1) 1 - xi else NA, regular = xi < 0.5),
    list(key = "asinh", lab = "asinh-Bregman", gen = make_gen("asinh", s_iqr), rate_m = 0.5, regular = TRUE))
  rows <- list(); recs <- list()
  for (p in p_levels) for (F in funs) {
    g <- F$gen; stat <- function(z) sq_emp(z, p, g)$SQ
    e  <- sq_emp(x, p, g)$SQ
    k  <- sq_kernel(x, p, g, h_ker)$SQ
    ri <- sq_recursive(x, p, g, "newton", "indicator")
    rk <- sq_recursive(x, p, g, "newton", "kernel")
    rp <- sq_recursive(x, p, g, "pr", "kernel")
    ok_n <- n * (1 - p) >= params$min_exceed; ok_m <- m * (1 - p) >= params$min_exceed
    w  <- if (F$regular && ok_n) wald_ci(x, p, g) else c(NA, NA)
    bn <- if (F$regular && ok_n) boot_ci(x, stat, n, 0.5, B) else c(NA, NA)
    bm <- if (is.finite(F$rate_m) && ok_m) boot_ci(x, stat, m, F$rate_m, B) else c(NA, NA)
    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(data = label, p = p, functional = F$lab, key = F$key,
      empirical = e, kernel = k, rec_ind = ri$SQ, rec_ker = rk$SQ, rec_pr = rp$SQ,
      wald_lo = w[1], wald_hi = w[2], boot_lo = bn[1], boot_hi = bn[2], mboot_lo = bm[1], mboot_hi = bm[2],
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    recs[[length(recs) + 1]] <- cbind(rbind(data.frame(ri$path, method = "Rec. indicator"),
                                            data.frame(rk$path, method = "Rec. kernel"),
                                            data.frame(rp$path, method = "Rec. PR")),
                                      p = p, functional = F$lab, batch = e)
  }
  list(tab = do.call(rbind, rows), rec = do.call(rbind, recs), xi = xi, s_iqr = s_iqr, m = m, n = n)
}
P_DAN <- c(0.95, 0.99, 0.995)
P_SP  <- c(0.50, 0.75, 0.90, 0.95, 0.975, 0.99, 0.995, 0.999)
t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
RES_dan <- analyse(x_dan, P_DAN, "Danish")
RES_sp  <- analyse(x_sp,  P_SP,  "S&P 500")
cat(sprintf("Elapsed: %.1f min\n", (proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0) / 60))
cat(sprintf("Danish: xi_hat (POT) = %.3f, s = IQR/1.349 = %.3f, m = %d.  S&P: xi_hat = %.3f, s = %.5f, m = %d\n",
            RES_dan$xi, RES_dan$s_iqr, RES_dan$m, RES_sp$xi, RES_sp$s_iqr, RES_sp$m))
kable(RES_dan$tab[, -4], digits = 3, caption = "Danish fire losses")
kable(RES_sp$tab[, -4], digits = 5, caption = "S&P 500 daily log-losses")
```

## POT–GPD CVaR with parametric-bootstrap intervals

```{r pot}
pot_table <- function(x, P) { M <- t(vapply(P, function(p) pot_ci(x, p, B = min(B, 1000)), numeric(3)))
  rownames(M) <- formatC(P, format = "g"); M }
POT_dan <- pot_table(x_dan, P_DAN)
POT_sp  <- pot_table(x_sp, P_SP[P_SP > 0.90])
kable(POT_dan, digits = 2, caption = "Danish: POT-GPD CVaR and 95% parametric-bootstrap interval")
kable(POT_sp, digits = 5, caption = "S&P 500: POT-GPD CVaR and 95% parametric-bootstrap interval")
```

## Recursive trajectories (chronological order)

```{r traj, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 9}
plot_traj <- function(R, name, title) {
  d <- R$rec; d$pl <- factor(sprintf("p = %s", formatC(d$p, format = "g")), levels = sprintf("p = %s", formatC(sort(unique(d$p)), format = "g")))
  d$functional <- factor(d$functional, levels = c("CVaR", "asinh-Bregman"))
  d$method <- factor(d$method, levels = c("Rec. indicator", "Rec. kernel", "Rec. PR"))
  b <- unique(d[, c("pl", "functional", "batch")])
  pl <- ggplot(d, aes(i, est, colour = method)) + geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_hline(data = b, aes(yintercept = batch), linetype = 2, colour = "grey30") +
    facet_grid(functional ~ pl, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_colour_manual(values = c("#E69F00", "#0072B2", "#CC79A7")) +
    labs(x = "number of observations (chronological order)", y = "recursive estimate", colour = NULL,
         title = title,
         subtitle = sprintf("Dashed: full-sample empirical estimate. Newton gains from the warm start; h_n = s_hat n^-%g; PR: steps n^-%g", params$a_rec, params$rho_pr)) +
    theme_article(12)
  save_fig(pl, name, 14, 9)
}
plot_traj(RES_dan, "fig_danish_recursive", "Danish fire losses: recursive estimates")
RES_sp_sub <- RES_sp; RES_sp_sub$rec <- subset(RES_sp$rec, p %in% c(0.95, 0.99, 0.995))
plot_traj(RES_sp_sub, "fig_sp_recursive", "S&P 500 daily log-losses: recursive estimates")
```


# The stable model

The stable law is fitted to the Boeing losses only (the Danish and S&P 500 losses are modelled by the GPD).

## Stable fit and parametric-bootstrap KS / CvM / AD tests

Minimum-distance fit on the empirical characteristic function, $S(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\delta;0)$; the parameters are
re-estimated on each parametric-bootstrap sample.

```{r stable-fit}
stable_cf <- function(t, alpha, beta, gamma, delta) {     # t > 0, S0 parameterisation
  if (abs(alpha - 1) < 1e-4) alpha <- 1 + 1e-4
  exp(-gamma^alpha * t^alpha * (1 + 1i * beta * tan(pi * alpha / 2) * ((gamma * t)^(1 - alpha) - 1)) + 1i * delta * t)
}
fit_stable_ecf <- function(x, t_grid = seq(0.1, 3, length.out = 60)) {
  m <- median(x); s <- robust_scale(x); z <- (x - m) / s
  phi_n <- sapply(t_grid, function(t) mean(exp(1i * t * z)))
  w <- exp(-t_grid / 2); w <- w / sum(w)
  obj <- function(par) {
    if (par[1] <= 0.5 || par[1] > 2 || abs(par[2]) > 1 || par[3] <= 0) return(1e10)
    sum(w * Mod(phi_n - stable_cf(t_grid, par[1], par[2], par[3], par[4]))^2)
  }
  starts <- expand.grid(a = c(1.2, 1.5, 1.8), b = c(0, 0.9)); best <- NULL
  for (k in seq_len(nrow(starts))) {
    fit <- tryCatch(optim(c(starts$a[k], starts$b[k], 1, 0), obj, method = "L-BFGS-B",
                          lower = c(0.51, -1, 1e-3, -50), upper = c(2, 1, 50, 50)), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(fit) && (is.null(best) || fit$value < best$value)) best <- fit
  }
  q <- best$par
  c(alpha = q[1], beta = q[2], gamma = s * q[3], delta = m + s * q[4])
}
rstable_par <- function(n, par) stabledist::rstable(n, alpha = par[["alpha"]], beta = par[["beta"]],
                                                     gamma = par[["gamma"]], delta = par[["delta"]], pm = 0)
gof_stats <- function(z) {
  z <- sort(pmin(pmax(z, 1e-12), 1 - 1e-12)); N <- length(z); i <- seq_len(N)
  c(KS  = max(i / N - z, z - (i - 1) / N),
    CvM = 1 / (12 * N) + sum((z - (2 * i - 1) / (2 * N))^2),
    AD  = -N - mean((2 * i - 1) * (log(z) + log(1 - rev(z)))))
}
stable_cdf_fast <- function(xv, par, ngrid = 250) {
  sx <- sort(xv)
  g <- sort(unique(c(as.numeric(quantile(sx, seq(0, 1, length.out = ngrid))), head(sx, 10), tail(sx, 40))))
  cdf <- stabledist::pstable(g, alpha = par[["alpha"]], beta = par[["beta"]],
                             gamma = par[["gamma"]], delta = par[["delta"]], pm = 0)
  approx(g, cdf, xout = xv, rule = 2)$y
}
stable_gof <- function(x, B) {
  par <- fit_stable_ecf(x); obs <- gof_stats(stable_cdf_fast(x, par))
  sims <- t(vapply(seq_len(B), function(b) {
    xs <- rstable_par(length(x), par)
    ps <- tryCatch(fit_stable_ecf(xs), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(ps)) rep(NA_real_, 3) else gof_stats(stable_cdf_fast(xs, ps)) }, numeric(3)))
  list(par = par, stat = obs, p = (1 + colSums(sweep(sims, 2, obs, ">="), na.rm = TRUE)) / (1 + colSums(!is.na(sims))))
}
SDATA <- DATA["Boeing daily log-losses"]   # the stable law is fitted to the Boeing losses only
GOF <- lapply(SDATA, stable_gof, B = B_gof)
kable(t(sapply(GOF, function(g) c(g$par, g$stat, p = g$p))), digits = 4,
      caption = "Stable fit (S0), KS/CvM/AD statistics and parametric-bootstrap p-values")
```

## QCV tests (Pitera, Chechkin & Wyłomańska, 2022) and exact Monte Carlo confidence sets

The sample quantile conditional variance $\widehat\sigma^2(a,b)$ is the variance of the order statistics
$X_{([na]+1)},\dots,X_{([nb])}$. The test statistic
$$N=\sqrt n\,\frac{d_1\widehat\sigma^2(a_1,a_2)+d_2\widehat\sigma^2(a_2,a_3)+d_3\widehat\sigma^2(a_3,a_4)}{\widehat\sigma^2(a_1,a_4)}$$
is invariant to location and scale. Designs of the paper: $N_1$ with $(a_1,a_2)=(0.05,0.25)$, $N_2$ with
$(0.005,0.25)$, $N_3$ with $(0.005,0.04)$, $a_3=1-a_2$, $a_4=1-a_1$.

* Under $H_0:X\sim S(\alpha_0,\beta_0,\gamma,\delta)$ the law of $N$ depends only on $(\alpha_0,\beta_0)$: the Monte
  Carlo test with $B_{mc}$ replications is **exact** (Dufour, 2006). Two-sided $p$-value $2\min(\hat q_-,\hat q_+)$.
* Inverting the three tests on a grid of $(\alpha_0,\beta_0)$ with a Bonferroni correction gives a confidence set of
  level at least $95\%$ (Beaulieu, Dufour & Khalaf, 2014); an **empty set** rejects the stable family at level $5\%$.
* Chambers–Mallows–Stuck simulation with common random numbers across the grid ($S_1$ parameterisation: a change of
  location does not change $N$).

```{r qcv}
QCV_DESIGNS <- list(N1 = list(a = c(0.05,  0.25, 0.75, 0.95),  d = c(1.00, -1.01, 1.00)),
                    N2 = list(a = c(0.005, 0.25, 0.75, 0.995), d = c(0.60, -1.61, 0.60)),
                    N3 = list(a = c(0.005, 0.04, 0.96, 0.995), d = c(1.15, -0.17, 1.15)))
qcv_sorted <- function(xs, a, b) { n <- length(xs); v <- xs[(floor(n * a) + 1):floor(n * b)]; mean((v - mean(v))^2) }
qcv_N <- function(x, sorted = FALSE) {
  xs <- if (sorted) x else sort(x); n <- length(xs)
  vapply(QCV_DESIGNS, function(D) { a <- D$a
    sqrt(n) * (D$d[1] * qcv_sorted(xs, a[1], a[2]) + D$d[2] * qcv_sorted(xs, a[2], a[3]) +
               D$d[3] * qcv_sorted(xs, a[3], a[4])) / qcv_sorted(xs, a[1], a[4]) }, numeric(1))
}
#' Chambers-Mallows-Stuck, S(alpha, beta, 1, 0; 1), from V ~ U(-pi/2, pi/2) and W ~ Exp(1) (matrices).
cms_s1 <- function(alpha, beta, V, W) {
  if (abs(alpha - 1) < 1e-8)
    return((2 / pi) * ((pi / 2 + beta * V) * tan(V) - beta * log((pi / 2) * W * cos(V) / (pi / 2 + beta * V))))
  Bab <- atan(beta * tan(pi * alpha / 2)) / alpha; Sab <- (1 + beta^2 * tan(pi * alpha / 2)^2)^(1 / (2 * alpha))
  Sab * sin(alpha * (V + Bab)) / cos(V)^(1 / alpha) * (cos(V - alpha * (V + Bab)) / W)^((1 - alpha) / alpha)
}
qcv_null <- function(alpha, beta, V, W) t(apply(cms_s1(alpha, beta, V, W), 2, function(z) qcv_N(sort(z), sorted = TRUE)))
qcv_pvalues <- function(N0, Ns) {
  lo <- (1 + colSums(sweep(Ns, 2, N0, "<="))) / (nrow(Ns) + 1)
  hi <- (1 + colSums(sweep(Ns, 2, N0, ">="))) / (nrow(Ns) + 1)
  pmin(1, 2 * pmin(lo, hi))
}
qcv_analysis <- function(x, fit, label) {
  n <- length(x); N0 <- qcv_N(x)
  V <- matrix(runif(n * B_mc, -pi / 2, pi / 2), n, B_mc); W <- matrix(rexp(n * B_mc), n, B_mc)
  p_fit <- qcv_pvalues(N0, qcv_null(fit[["alpha"]], fit[["beta"]], V, W))
  grid <- expand.grid(alpha = seq(if (QUICK) 0.6 else 0.5, 2, by = if (QUICK) 0.1 else 0.05),
                      beta = seq(-1, 1, by = if (QUICK) 0.5 else 0.25))
  P <- t(vapply(seq_len(nrow(grid)), function(j) qcv_pvalues(N0, qcv_null(grid$alpha[j], grid$beta[j], V, W)),
                numeric(3)))
  grid <- cbind(grid, P, pmin = apply(P, 1, min)); grid$accepted <- grid$pmin > 0.05 / 3; grid$data <- label
  list(N = N0, p_fit = p_fit, grid = grid,
       alpha_range = if (any(grid$accepted)) range(grid$alpha[grid$accepted]) else c(NA, NA))
}
t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]
QCV <- Map(qcv_analysis, SDATA, lapply(GOF, `[[`, "par"), names(SDATA))
cat(sprintf("QCV: %.1f min\n", (proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0) / 60))
kable(t(sapply(QCV, function(q) c(q$N, p = q$p_fit, alpha_lo = q$alpha_range[1], alpha_hi = q$alpha_range[2]))),
      digits = 3, caption = "QCV statistics, plug-in Monte Carlo p-values at the fitted (alpha, beta), and 95% confidence set for alpha (NA: empty)")

G <- do.call(rbind, lapply(QCV, `[[`, "grid")); G$data <- factor(G$data, levels = names(SDATA))
pts <- data.frame(data = factor(names(SDATA), levels = names(SDATA)),
                  alpha = sapply(GOF, function(g) g$par[["alpha"]]), beta = sapply(GOF, function(g) g$par[["beta"]]))
pl <- ggplot(G, aes(alpha, beta, fill = pmin)) + geom_tile() +
  geom_point(data = subset(G, accepted), aes(alpha, beta), inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 4, size = 2) +
  geom_point(data = pts, aes(alpha, beta), inherit.aes = FALSE, shape = 21, size = 4, fill = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(trans = "sqrt", limits = c(0, 1)) + facet_wrap(~ data) +
  labs(x = expression(alpha[0]), y = expression(beta[0]), fill = "min p-value",
       title = "Exact QCV Monte Carlo tests of H0: X ~ S(alpha0, beta0, gamma, delta)",
       subtitle = "Crosses: points of the 95% confidence set (Bonferroni over N1, N2, N3); circle: ECF fit") +
  theme_article(13)
save_fig(pl, "fig_stable_qcv", 15, 6)
```

## Tail index: is $1/\widehat\alpha$ consistent with the tail?

A non-Gaussian stable law has $\xi=1/\alpha>1/2$. For $\alpha$ close to $2$, however, the Pareto regime starts far in
the tail and the Hill estimator computed at usual $k$ is strongly biased downwards (McCulloch, 1997; Weron, 2001):
comparing $1/\widehat\alpha$ with $\widehat\xi$ directly is misleading. We therefore compare the estimates of $\xi$ on the
data (Hill and QQ-estimator of Kratz & Resnick, 1996, at $k=\lfloor\sqrt{n_+}\rfloor$; POT–GPD at $u=Q_{0.90}$) with
their distribution over `R_tail` samples of the same size simulated from the fitted stable law. A two-sided Monte Carlo
$p$-value below $0.05$ means that the tail of the data is not the tail of the fitted stable law.

```{r tailindex, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 6}
hill_curve <- function(x, ks) { ls <- log(sort(x[x > 0], decreasing = TRUE)); cs <- cumsum(ls); cs[ks] / ks - ls[ks + 1] }
qq_curve <- function(x, ks) { ls <- log(sort(x[x > 0], decreasing = TRUE))
  vapply(ks, function(k) { u <- -log(seq_len(k) / (k + 1)); y <- ls[1:k]
    sum((u - mean(u)) * (y - mean(y))) / sum((u - mean(u))^2) }, 1) }
xi_three <- function(x) {
  k <- floor(sqrt(sum(x > 0))); u <- quantile(x, 0.90, type = 1, names = FALSE)
  c(hill = hill(x[x > 0], k), qq = qq_xi(x, k), gpd = gpd_fit(x[x > u] - u)[["xi"]])
}
tail_calibration <- function(x, par, label) {
  ks <- seq(10, min(floor(sum(x > 0) / 4), 600), by = 5)
  sims <- replicate(R_tail, { xs <- rstable_par(length(x), par)
    list(xi = xi_three(xs), hill = hill_curve(xs, ks), qq = qq_curve(xs, ks)) }, simplify = FALSE)
  XI <- t(sapply(sims, `[[`, "xi")); obs <- xi_three(x)
  pv <- sapply(names(obs), function(j) min(1, 2 * min((1 + sum(XI[, j] <= obs[[j]])) / (R_tail + 1),
                                                      (1 + sum(XI[, j] >= obs[[j]])) / (R_tail + 1))))
  band <- function(M) t(apply(M, 2, quantile, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975), na.rm = TRUE))
  bh <- band(do.call(rbind, lapply(sims, `[[`, "hill"))); bq <- band(do.call(rbind, lapply(sims, `[[`, "qq")))
  curves <- rbind(data.frame(data = label, k = ks, est = hill_curve(x, ks), lo = bh[, 1], med = bh[, 2], hi = bh[, 3], method = "Hill"),
                  data.frame(data = label, k = ks, est = qq_curve(x, ks), lo = bq[, 1], med = bq[, 2], hi = bq[, 3], method = "QQ-estimator"))
  list(obs = obs, sim_lo = apply(XI, 2, quantile, 0.025), sim_hi = apply(XI, 2, quantile, 0.975), p = pv,
       inv_alpha = 1 / par[["alpha"]], curves = curves)
}
TAILC <- Map(tail_calibration, SDATA, lapply(GOF, `[[`, "par"), names(SDATA))
kable(t(sapply(TAILC, function(T) c(inv_alpha = T$inv_alpha, T$obs, p = T$p))), digits = 3,
      caption = "1/alpha_hat, estimates of xi on the data and Monte Carlo p-values under the fitted stable law")
CU <- do.call(rbind, lapply(TAILC, `[[`, "curves")); CU$data <- factor(CU$data, levels = names(SDATA))
ref <- data.frame(data = factor(names(SDATA), levels = names(SDATA)), inv_alpha = sapply(TAILC, `[[`, "inv_alpha"))
pl <- ggplot(CU, aes(k)) + geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi, fill = method), alpha = 0.2) +
  geom_line(aes(y = est, colour = method), linewidth = 0.9) +
  geom_hline(data = ref, aes(yintercept = inv_alpha), linetype = 2) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.5, colour = "grey50") +
  facet_wrap(~ data, scales = "free") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00")) + scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00")) +
  labs(x = "number k of upper order statistics", y = "estimate of xi", colour = NULL, fill = NULL,
       title = "Tail index of the data against the fitted stable law",
       subtitle = "Lines: data; bands: 95% range of the same estimator on samples from the fitted stable law; dashed: 1/alpha_hat; grey: xi = 1/2") +
  theme_article(13)
save_fig(pl, "fig_tail_index", 15, 6)
```

## Aggregation diagnostic (Burnecki, Wyłomańska & Chechkin, 2015)

Block sums of $K$ consecutive observations of an $\alpha$-stable sample are $\alpha$-stable; for data in the Gaussian domain
of attraction $\widehat\alpha_K$ drifts towards $2$. Graphical diagnostic, not a formal test.

```{r aggregation, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 6}
aggregate_alpha <- function(x, label, Kmax = 10) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(seq_len(Kmax), function(K) {
    nb <- floor(length(x) / K); S <- colSums(matrix(x[seq_len(nb * K)], nrow = K))
    a0 <- fit_stable_ecf(S)[["alpha"]]
    ab <- vapply(seq_len(B_agg), function(b) fit_stable_ecf(sample(S, nb, replace = TRUE))[["alpha"]], 1)
    data.frame(data = label, K = K, alpha = c(a0, ab), type = c("estimate", rep("bootstrap", B_agg)))
  }))
}
AGG <- do.call(rbind, Map(aggregate_alpha, SDATA, names(SDATA))); AGG$data <- factor(AGG$data, levels = names(SDATA))
pl <- ggplot(subset(AGG, type == "bootstrap"), aes(factor(K), alpha)) + geom_boxplot(outlier.size = 0.6, fill = "grey90") +
  geom_point(data = subset(AGG, type == "estimate"), colour = "#D55E00", size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 2, linetype = 2) + facet_wrap(~ data) +
  labs(x = "aggregation level K (sums of K consecutive observations)", y = expression(hat(alpha)[K]),
       title = "Stability index of aggregated data", subtitle = "Red: estimate on the aggregated sample; boxes: bootstrap") +
  theme_article(13)
save_fig(pl, "fig_stable_aggregation", 15, 6)
AGG_SUM <- with(subset(AGG, type == "estimate"), tapply(alpha, list(as.character(data), K), identity))
kable(AGG_SUM, digits = 3, caption = "alpha_K fitted to the aggregated samples")
```

## Boeing losses: superquantiles under the stable model

For the Boeing losses the regime is decided by the fitted stable law: $\xi=1/\widehat\alpha$. The superquantiles
implied by the fitted law are computed from the representation of Theorem 6.1,
$\mathrm{CVaR}_p=Q_p+\frac1{1-p}\int_{Q_p}^\infty\Prob(X>t)\,dt$, and, for the $\asinh$ generator, by integration by parts,
$\E[\asinh(X/s)\mid X\ge Q_p]=\asinh(Q_p/s)+\frac1{1-p}\int_{Q_p}^\infty\frac{\Prob(X>t)}{\sqrt{s^2+t^2}}\,dt$.

```{r boeing, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 9}
PAR_ba <- GOF$`Boeing daily log-losses`$par
stable_sq_model <- function(p, par, s) {
  sf <- function(t) stabledist::pstable(t, alpha = par[["alpha"]], beta = par[["beta"]], gamma = par[["gamma"]],
                                        delta = par[["delta"]], pm = 0, lower.tail = FALSE)
  Q <- stabledist::qstable(p, alpha = par[["alpha"]], beta = par[["beta"]], gamma = par[["gamma"]],
                           delta = par[["delta"]], pm = 0)
  I1 <- tryCatch(integrate(sf, Q, Inf, rel.tol = 1e-8, subdivisions = 1000L)$value, error = function(e) NA_real_)
  I2 <- tryCatch(integrate(function(t) sf(t) / sqrt(s^2 + t^2), Q, Inf, rel.tol = 1e-8, subdivisions = 1000L)$value,
                 error = function(e) NA_real_)
  c(Q = Q, cvar = if (par[["alpha"]] > 1) Q + I1 / (1 - p) else Inf, asinh = s * sinh(asinh(Q / s) + I2 / (1 - p)))
}
P_BA <- c(0.95, 0.99, 0.995)
RES_ba <- analyse(x_ba, P_BA, "Boeing", xi_regime = 1 / PAR_ba[["alpha"]])
MOD_ba <- t(vapply(P_BA, stable_sq_model, numeric(3), par = PAR_ba, s = RES_ba$s_iqr)); rownames(MOD_ba) <- formatC(P_BA, format = "g")
kable(RES_ba$tab[, -4], digits = 5, caption = "Boeing daily log-losses: nonparametric estimates and intervals")
kable(MOD_ba, digits = 5, caption = "Boeing: quantile, CVaR and asinh-Bregman superquantile of the fitted stable law")
plot_traj(RES_ba, "fig_boeing_recursive", "Boeing daily log-losses: recursive estimates")
```

## Boeing losses: stable parameters from Bregman superquantiles (Section 6)

The functions below are those of the companion notebook `stable_parameters_superquantiles.Rmd`. For
$X\sim S_0(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,\zeta)$, $1<\alpha\le2$, Theorem 6.1 gives $H(Q;\theta)=\E_\theta[(X-Q)^+]$ through Nolan's
integral $g_{-1}$, and the quadratic superquantile satisfies exactly $T_p=Q_p+H(Q_p;\theta)/(1-p)$. The parameters
minimise $J(\theta)=\sum_i[(\widehat T_{p_i}-T_\theta(\widehat Q_{p_i}))/(1+|\widehat T_{p_i}|)]^2$ over the levels
$p\in\{0.25,0.5,0.75,0.95\}$ of both tails, with the five superquantile estimators, on the data standardised by the
median and IQR/1.349. The ECF fit is the benchmark. The model-implied CVaR of the next table uses the same
representation, $\mathrm{CVaR}_p=Q_p+H(Q_p;\widehat\theta)/(1-p)$.

```{r boeing-sqfit}
make_generator <- function(name, s = 1, a = 0.5) {
  switch(name,
    quad = list(name = "quad", label = "Quadratic (exact)",
                g1 = function(x) x, g2 = function(x) rep(1, length(x)), ginv = function(y) y),
    asinh = list(name = "asinh", label = "asinh (linearised)",
                 g1 = function(x) asinh(x / s), g2 = function(x) 1 / (s * sqrt(1 + (x / s)^2)),
                 ginv = function(y) s * sinh(y)),
    sin = list(name = "sin", label = "x + a cos x (linearised)",
               g1 = function(x) x + a * cos(x), g2 = function(x) 1 - a * sin(x),
               ginv = function(y) { x <- y; for (k in 1:60) x <- x - (x + a * cos(x) - y) / (1 - a * sin(x)); x }),
    stop("Unknown generator: ", name))
}
GENS <- list(quad = make_generator("quad"), asinh = make_generator("asinh"), sin = make_generator("sin"))
gen_lab <- vapply(GENS, `[[`, "", "label")

gauss_legendre <- function(m) {
  i <- seq_len(m - 1); b <- i / sqrt(4 * i^2 - 1)
  J <- matrix(0, m, m); J[cbind(i, i + 1)] <- b; J[cbind(i + 1, i)] <- b
  e <- eigen(J, symmetric = TRUE); o <- order(e$values)
  list(x = e$values[o], w = 2 * e$vectors[1, o]^2)
}
.GL20 <- gauss_legendre(20); .GL40 <- gauss_legendre(40)

#' g_{-1}(x | alpha, beta): composite Gauss-Legendre in r on [0, 34^(1/alpha)] (exp(-r^alpha) < 1e-14 beyond).
#' The form -2 sin^2(u/2) = cos(u) - 1 avoids cancellation near r = 0.
g_m1 <- function(x, alpha, beta) {
  tn <- tan(pi * alpha / 2); R <- 34^(1 / alpha)
  phase <- max(abs(x)) * R + abs(beta * tn) * R^alpha
  npan <- min(400, max(8, ceiling(phase / 12)))
  edges <- seq(0, R, length.out = npan + 1); a <- edges[-length(edges)]; b <- edges[-1]
  half <- (b - a) / 2; mid <- (a + b) / 2
  r <- as.vector(outer(.GL20$x, half) + matrix(mid, 20, npan, byrow = TRUE))
  w <- as.vector(outer(.GL20$w, half)); er <- exp(-r^alpha) / r^2; rA <- r^alpha
  vapply(x, function(xi) sum(w * (-2 * sin((xi * r - beta * tn * rA) / 2)^2) * er), numeric(1))
}
#' Theorem 6.1: E[(X - Q)^+], X ~ S0(alpha, beta, gam, zeta), alpha > 1 (vectorised in Q).
H_stable <- function(Q, alpha, beta, gam = 1, zeta = 0) {
  tn <- tan(pi * alpha / 2); z <- (Q - zeta + beta * gam * tn) / gam
  0.5 * (zeta - beta * gam * tn - Q) + (gam / pi) * (base::gamma(1 - 1 / alpha) - g_m1(z, alpha, beta))
}
#' Model statistic T_theta(Q) = gamma'(Q) + gamma''(Q) H(Q; theta) / (1 - p)  (exact for quad).
T_model <- function(Q, alpha, beta, gam, zeta, gen, p)
  gen$g1(Q) + gen$g2(Q) * H_stable(Q, alpha, beta, gam, zeta) / (1 - p)
n0_rule <- function(p) as.integer(max(200, ceiling(20 / (1 - p))))

est_emp <- function(x, P, gen) {
  xs <- sort(x); n <- length(xs); G <- cumsum(rev(gen$g1(xs)))      # G[j] = sum of the j largest g1(x)
  t(vapply(P, function(p) {
    k <- ceiling(n * p - 1e-9); q <- xs[k]; up <- if (k < n) G[n - k] else 0
    c(Q = q, T = ((k - n * p) * gen$g1(q) + up) / (n * (1 - p)))
  }, numeric(2)))
}
kernel_quantile <- function(x, p, h, start) {
  t <- start
  for (it in 1:30) {
    z <- (t - x) / h; Fv <- mean(pnorm(z)) - p; dv <- mean(dnorm(z)) / h
    if (!is.finite(dv) || dv < 1e-12) break
    st <- Fv / dv; t <- t - st
    if (abs(st) < 1e-10 * (1 + abs(t))) return(t)
  }
  tryCatch(uniroot(function(t) mean(pnorm((t - x) / h)) - p, range(x) + c(-8, 8) * h)$root, error = function(e) NA_real_)
}
est_kernel <- function(x, P, gen, h) {
  xs <- sort(x); n <- length(x)
  t(vapply(P, function(p) {
    q <- kernel_quantile(x, p, h, xs[ceiling(n * p - 1e-9)])
    if (!is.finite(q)) return(c(Q = NA_real_, T = NA_real_))
    a <- (q - x) / h
    if (gen$name == "quad") return(c(Q = q, T = sum(x * pnorm(-a) + h * dnorm(a)) / (n * (1 - p))))
    far <- a < -8; band <- abs(a) <= 8
    ab <- a[band]; half <- (8 - ab) / 2; mid <- (8 + ab) / 2; Z <- outer(half, .GL40$x) + mid
    s_band <- sum(drop((gen$g1(x[band] + h * Z) * dnorm(Z)) %*% .GL40$w) * half)
    c(Q = q, T = (sum(gen$g1(x[far])) + s_band) / (n * (1 - p)))
  }, numeric(2)))
}
#' Recursive estimators (revised algorithm) with Newton gains: warm start, gain 1/f_hat on Q and the
#' control-variate correction -gamma'(Q)(W - p)/(1 - p) in the theta-recursion.
#' type = "indicator": W = 1{X <= Q}, step 1/i; "kernel": W = Phi((Q - X)/h_i), h_i = i^-a, step 1/i;
#' "pr": kernel version with step i^-0.8, h_i = i^-0.4 and Polyak-Ruppert averaging of the theta-iterates.
est_recursive <- function(x, P, gen, type = c("kernel", "indicator", "pr"), a = 0.3, rho = 0.8) {
  type <- match.arg(type); n <- length(x); r <- 1 - P
  n0 <- min(max(vapply(P, n0_rule, 1L)), floor(n / 4))
  w0 <- est_emp(x[1:n0], P, gen); Q <- w0[, "Q"]; T <- w0[, "T"]; Tbar <- T
  x0 <- x[1:n0]; hp <- robust_scale(x0) * n0^(-0.2)
  fq <- vapply(Q, function(q) mean(dnorm((q - x0) / hp)) / hp, 1)
  gq <- 1 / pmax(fq, 0.1 * r / robust_scale(x0))
  g1x <- gen$g1(x)
  for (i in (n0 + 1):n) {
    xi <- x[i]; st <- if (type == "pr") i^(-rho) else 1 / i
    W <- if (type == "indicator") as.numeric(xi <= Q) else pnorm((Q - xi) * i^a)
    T <- T - st * (T - g1x[i] * (1 - W) / r - gen$g1(Q) * (W - P) / r)
    Q <- Q - st * gq * (W - P)
    if (type == "pr") Tbar <- Tbar + (T - Tbar) / (i - n0)
  }
  cbind(Q = Q, T = if (type == "pr") Tbar else T)
}
superquantile_stats <- function(z, estimator, gen, P, a = 0.3) {
  switch(estimator,
    empirical           = est_emp(z, P, gen),
    kernel              = est_kernel(z, P, gen, length(z)^(-a)),
    recursive_indicator = est_recursive(z, P, gen, "indicator", a),
    recursive_kernel    = est_recursive(z, P, gen, "kernel", a),
    recursive_pr        = est_recursive(z, P, gen, "pr", a = 0.4, rho = 0.8),   # best choice (article, Table rho)
    stop("Unknown estimator: ", estimator))
}
#' Statistics on the standardised sample, upper tail and (optionally) lower tail.
stats_thm <- function(x, estimator, gen, P, a = 0.3, two_sided = TRUE) {
  m <- median(x); s <- robust_scale(x); z <- (x - m) / s
  up <- superquantile_stats(z, estimator, gen, P, a)
  out <- list(levels = P, m = m, s = s, Q_up = up[, "Q"], T_up = up[, "T"])
  if (two_sided) { lo <- superquantile_stats(-z, estimator, gen, P, a); out$Q_lo <- lo[, "Q"]; out$T_lo <- lo[, "T"] }
  out
}

superquantile_stats <- function(z, estimator, gen, P, a = 0.3) {
  switch(estimator,
    empirical           = est_emp(z, P, gen),
    kernel              = est_kernel(z, P, gen, length(z)^(-a)),
    recursive_indicator = est_recursive(z, P, gen, "indicator", a),
    recursive_kernel    = est_recursive(z, P, gen, "kernel", a),
    recursive_pr        = est_recursive(z, P, gen, "pr", a = 0.4, rho = 0.8),
    stop("Unknown estimator: ", estimator))
}
stats_thm <- function(x, estimator, gen, P, a = 0.3, two_sided = TRUE) {
  m <- median(x); s <- robust_scale(x); z <- (x - m) / s
  up <- superquantile_stats(z, estimator, gen, P, a)
  out <- list(levels = P, m = m, s = s, Q_up = up[, "Q"], T_up = up[, "T"])
  if (two_sided) { lo <- superquantile_stats(-z, estimator, gen, P, a); out$Q_lo <- lo[, "Q"]; out$T_lo <- lo[, "T"] }
  out
}
.lo <- c(1.05, -0.95, 0.05, -5); .hi <- c(2, 0.95, 10, 5)
OPTIMIZERS <- c("lbfgsb", "neldermead", "nlminb", "de", "de+lbfgsb")
obj_thm <- function(par, st, gen) {
  a <- par[1]; b <- par[2]; g <- par[3]; zt <- par[4]
  if (a <= 1.02 || a > 2 || abs(b) > 0.99 || g <= 0) return(1e10)
  res <- (st$T_up - T_model(st$Q_up, a, b, g, zt, gen, st$levels)) / (1 + abs(st$T_up))
  if (!is.null(st$Q_lo))
    res <- c(res, (st$T_lo - T_model(st$Q_lo, a, -b, g, -zt, gen, st$levels)) / (1 + abs(st$T_lo)))
  v <- sum(res^2); if (is.finite(v)) v else 1e10
}
.starts <- function() expand.grid(a = c(1.3, 1.6, 1.9), b = c(-0.4, 0, 0.4), g = c(0.5, 1), z = 0)
.tr  <- function(u) c(1.05 + 0.95 * plogis(u[1]), 0.95 * tanh(u[2]), exp(u[3]), 5 * tanh(u[4]))   # R^4 -> box
.inv <- function(p) c(qlogis((p[1] - 1.05) / 0.95), atanh(p[2] / 0.95), log(p[3]), atanh(p[4] / 5))
.multistart <- function(f, solver, k = 3) {
  S <- .starts(); v0 <- apply(S, 1, f); best <- NULL
  for (i in order(v0)[seq_len(k)]) {
    fit <- tryCatch(solver(as.numeric(S[i, ])), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (!is.null(fit) && is.finite(fit$value) && (is.null(best) || fit$value < best$value)) best <- fit
  }
  if (is.null(best)) { i <- which.min(v0); best <- list(par = as.numeric(S[i, ]), value = v0[i], conv = 99L) }
  best
}
opt_lbfgsb <- function(f) .multistart(f, function(s0) {
  o <- optim(s0, f, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = .lo, upper = .hi, control = list(maxit = 200))
  list(par = o$par, value = o$value, conv = o$convergence) })
opt_nm <- function(f) .multistart(function(p) f(p), function(s0) {
  o <- optim(.inv(pmin(pmax(s0, .lo + 1e-6), .hi - 1e-6)), function(u) f(.tr(u)), method = "Nelder-Mead",
             control = list(maxit = 800, reltol = 1e-10))
  list(par = .tr(o$par), value = o$value, conv = o$convergence) })
opt_nlminb <- function(f) .multistart(f, function(s0) {
  o <- nlminb(s0, f, lower = .lo, upper = .hi, control = list(iter.max = 300))
  list(par = o$par, value = o$objective, conv = o$convergence) })
opt_de <- function(f, NP = 40, G = 60, Fw = 0.7, CR = 0.8) {          # DE/rand/1/bin (global search)
  d <- 4; Pm <- sweep(sweep(matrix(runif(NP * d), NP, d), 2, .hi - .lo, "*"), 2, .lo, "+"); v <- apply(Pm, 1, f)
  for (g in seq_len(G)) for (i in seq_len(NP)) {
    idx <- sample(setdiff(seq_len(NP), i), 3)
    mut <- pmin(pmax(Pm[idx[1], ] + Fw * (Pm[idx[2], ] - Pm[idx[3], ]), .lo), .hi)
    cross <- runif(d) < CR; cross[sample.int(d, 1)] <- TRUE
    trial <- ifelse(cross, mut, Pm[i, ]); vt <- f(trial)
    if (vt <= v[i]) { Pm[i, ] <- trial; v[i] <- vt }
  }
  i <- which.min(v); list(par = Pm[i, ], value = v[i], conv = 0L)
}
opt_hybrid <- function(f) {                                           # DE exploration + L-BFGS-B polishing
  d <- opt_de(f, NP = 30, G = 30)
  o <- tryCatch(optim(d$par, f, method = "L-BFGS-B", lower = .lo, upper = .hi, control = list(maxit = 200)),
                error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(o) && o$value <= d$value) list(par = o$par, value = o$value, conv = o$convergence) else d
}
run_optimizer <- function(f, method) switch(method,
  lbfgsb = opt_lbfgsb(f), neldermead = opt_nm(f), nlminb = opt_nlminb(f), de = opt_de(f), `de+lbfgsb` = opt_hybrid(f),
  stop("Unknown optimizer: ", method))

fit_from_stats <- function(st, gen, optimizer = "nlminb") {
  cnt <- 0L
  f <- function(par) { cnt <<- cnt + 1L; tryCatch(obj_thm(par, st, gen), error = function(e) 1e10) }
  t0 <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]]; o <- run_optimizer(f, optimizer); tm <- proc.time()[["elapsed"]] - t0
  list(alpha = o$par[1], beta = o$par[2], gamma = st$s * o$par[3], zeta = st$m + st$s * o$par[4],
       obj = o$value, conv = o$conv, nfev = cnt, time_opt = tm)
}

ESTIMATORS <- c("empirical", "kernel", "recursive_indicator", "recursive_kernel", "recursive_pr")
est_lab <- c(empirical = "Empirical", kernel = "Kernel", recursive_indicator = "Rec. indicator",
             recursive_kernel = "Rec. kernel", recursive_pr = "Rec. PR")
P_FIT <- c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.95)
FIT_ba <- do.call(rbind, lapply(ESTIMATORS, function(E) {
  r <- fit_from_stats(stats_thm(x_ba, E, GENS$quad, P_FIT, 0.3, TRUE), GENS$quad, "nlminb")
  data.frame(method = est_lab[[E]], alpha = r$alpha, beta = r$beta, gamma = r$gamma, zeta = r$zeta, obj = r$obj)
}))
FIT_ba <- rbind(FIT_ba, data.frame(method = "ECF", alpha = PAR_ba[["alpha"]], beta = PAR_ba[["beta"]],
                                   gamma = PAR_ba[["gamma"]], zeta = PAR_ba[["delta"]], obj = NA))
if (!is.null(MIX)) FIT_ba <- rbind(FIT_ba, data.frame(method = "ML (MixStable)", alpha = MIX["Boeing daily log-losses", "alpha_mle"],
                                   beta = MIX["Boeing daily log-losses", "beta_mle"], gamma = NA, zeta = NA, obj = NA))
kable(FIT_ba, digits = 4, caption = "Boeing daily log-losses: stable parameters from quadratic Bregman superquantiles (Theorem 6.1) and benchmarks")
## superquantiles of the stable law fitted by quadratic Bregman superquantiles (empirical estimator; Table 24)
f1 <- FIT_ba[FIT_ba$method == "Empirical", ]
PAR_sq <- c(alpha = f1$alpha, beta = f1$beta, gamma = f1$gamma, delta = f1$zeta)
MOD_sq <- t(vapply(P_BA, stable_sq_model, numeric(3), par = PAR_sq, s = RES_ba$s_iqr)); rownames(MOD_sq) <- formatC(P_BA, format = "g")
MOD_sq[, "cvar"] <- MOD_sq[, "Q"] + H_stable(MOD_sq[, "Q"], PAR_sq[["alpha"]], PAR_sq[["beta"]], PAR_sq[["gamma"]], PAR_sq[["delta"]]) / (1 - P_BA)

MOD_ba[, "cvar"] <- Q_mod + H_stable(Q_mod, PAR_ba[["alpha"]], PAR_ba[["beta"]], PAR_ba[["gamma"]], PAR_ba[["delta"]]) / (1 - P_BA)
```

```{r latex}
#' Superquantile estimates: panel A (CVaR), panel B (asinh-Bregman); optional last column `extra`
#' (list(cvar = named vector, asinh = named vector), names = formatted p).
tex_sq <- function(R, name, caption, label, d = 2, extra = NULL, extra_lab = "") {
  T <- R$tab; nc <- if (is.null(extra)) 6 else 7
  L <- c("\\begin{table}[!htbp]\\centering", sprintf("\\caption{%s}\\label{%s}", caption, label),
         "\\small\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{5pt}", sprintf("\\begin{tabular}{%s}\\toprule", strrep("r", nc)),
         paste0("$p$ & Empirical & Kernel & Rec.\\ indicator & Rec.\\ kernel & Rec.\\ PR",
                if (nc == 7) paste0(" & ", extra_lab) else "", "\\\\\\midrule"))
  for (key in c("cvar", "asinh")) {
    L <- c(L, sprintf("\\multicolumn{%d}{l}{\\emph{%s}}\\\\", nc,
                      if (key == "cvar") "CVaR (quadratic generator)" else
                        sprintf("$\\asinh$-Bregman superquantile ($s=%s$)", formatC(R$s_iqr, format = "g", digits = 4))))
    S <- T[T$key == key, ]
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(S))) {
      pk <- formatC(S$p[i], format = "g")
      ev <- if (nc == 7) { v <- extra[[key]]; if (!is.null(v) && pk %in% names(v)) paste0(" & ", fmt(v[[pk]], d)) else " & " } else ""
      L <- c(L, sprintf("%s & %s & %s & %s & %s & %s%s\\\\", pk, fmt(S$empirical[i], d), fmt(S$kernel[i], d),
                        fmt(S$rec_ind[i], d), fmt(S$rec_ker[i], d), fmt(S$rec_pr[i], d), ev))
    }
    if (key == "cvar") L <- c(L, "\\midrule")
  }
  write_tex(c(L, "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}", "\\end{table}"), name)
}
tex_ci <- function(R, name, caption, label, d = 2, pot = NULL) {
  T <- R$tab
  L <- c("\\begin{table}[!htbp]\\centering", sprintf("\\caption{%s}\\label{%s}", caption, label),
         "\\small\\setlength{\\tabcolsep}{4pt}", "\\begin{tabular}{rlrlll}\\toprule",
         "$p$ & Functional & Estimate & Wald & Bootstrap ($n$ out of $n$) & Bootstrap ($m$ out of $n$)\\\\\\midrule")
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(T))) {
    pk <- formatC(T$p[i], format = "g"); lab <- if (T$key[i] == "cvar") "CVaR" else "$\\asinh$"
    L <- c(L, sprintf("%s & %s & %s & %s & %s & %s\\\\", pk, lab, fmt(T$empirical[i], d),
                      fmt_ci(c(T$wald_lo[i], T$wald_hi[i]), d), fmt_ci(c(T$boot_lo[i], T$boot_hi[i]), d),
                      fmt_ci(c(T$mboot_lo[i], T$mboot_hi[i]), d)))
    if (!is.null(pot) && T$key[i] == "cvar" && pk %in% rownames(pot))
      L <- c(L, sprintf(" & CVaR, POT--GPD & %s & \\multicolumn{3}{l}{parametric bootstrap %s}\\\\",
                        fmt(pot[pk, "est"], d), fmt_ci(pot[pk, c("lo", "hi")], d)))
    if (i < nrow(T) && T$p[i + 1] != T$p[i]) L <- c(L, "\\midrule")
  }
  write_tex(c(L, "\\bottomrule", "\\end{tabular}", "\\end{table}"), name)
}
```
